By email and by hard copy

content_sections.heading: About RPCAU
content_sections.text: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University is an agricultural university located at Pusa in Samastipur, Bihar. This post sits with the office of its Vice Chancellor, and the Recruitment Section is handling the applications.

content_sections.heading: RPCAU Officer on Special Duty Vacancy Details 2026

rows.post: Officer on Special Duty to the Vice Chancellor (on Contract/Deputation)

content_sections.heading: RPCAU Officer on Special Duty Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Not more than 65 years as on the closing date of application. Mandatory requirements: Qualification: Bachelor in relevant field. Experience: Minimum 03 years in Central/State Government/PSUs at Pay Level-10. Officers from Central/State Government/PSUs having considerable experience of functioning in administration would be considered. The Officer on Special Duty should have excellent communication and interpersonal skill. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Nature of Work
content_sections.text: Secretarial work related to implementing the schemes of the University/Organization, preparing SFC/EFC memos, drafting in files, and preparing agenda and business notes as assigned by the University. Managing offices and senior-level secretarial services (Finance and Administration) to ensure a high level of efficiency and effectiveness in office administration. Work related to finance, accounts, audit, GFRs, construction contracts, administration and establishment, along with any other matters the University requires from time to time. Secretariat matters, RTI, court cases, grievance redressal and contract executions.

rows.event: Last date for hard copy submission

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received are shortlisted on the basis of the applicants' experience and qualification. The Officer on Special Duty is selected or nominated from the shortlisted candidates. The University reserves the right to reject an application without giving any reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Period of engagement: Initially one year. It may be extended depending on the officer's performance or the functional requirement of the Office, with the approval of the Competent Authority. Nature of engagement: Purely short-term contract basis. Place of work: The notice is issued for the University at Pusa, Samastipur, Bihar. Confidentiality: Intellectual Property Rights in the data collected and the deliverables produced remain with the office. No data, statistics, proceedings or information from the assignment may be used, published or disclosed to a third party without the office's express written consent. Handing over records: The officer must hand over the entire set of assignment records before the contract expires and before the final payment is released. Conflict of interest: The officer shall in no case represent or advise others in any matter adverse to the University's interest. Taking up another assignment during the engagement requires permission from the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RPCAU Officer on Special Duty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists two steps joined by "AND", so complete both by 23 November 2026. Email a detailed resume with the duly filled application form and self-attested supporting documents, in the prescribed format, to [email protected] . Submit a hard copy of the resume, duly filled form and self-attested supporting documents to the Deputy Registrar, Recruitment Section, RPCAU, Pusa, Samastipur (Bihar), Pin Code-848125. Documents to send: Detailed resume Duly filled application form Self-attested supporting documents

faq.question: Q1. Is one application method enough for this post?
faq.answer: No. The notice joins the two methods with "AND", so the application goes to [email protected] and a hard copy goes to the Deputy Registrar, Recruitment Section.

faq.question: Q2. What experience does the Officer on Special Duty post require?
faq.answer: Candidates need a minimum of 03 years in Central/State Government/PSUs at Pay Level-10. The notice also says officers with considerable experience of functioning in administration would be considered.

faq.question: Q3. How is the age limit counted?
faq.answer: Age must be not more than 65 years, counted as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: The notice describes the hiring as purely on a Contract/Deputation basis. The engagement runs initially for one year and may be extended.

faq.question: Q5. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: The notice's selection procedure lists shortlisting on experience and qualification, followed by selection or nomination from the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What work will the officer handle?
faq.answer: The duties include preparing SFC/EFC memos, agenda and business notes, along with work on finance, audit, GFRs, RTI, court cases and grievance redressal.

faq.question: Q7. Can the selected officer take up other work during the engagement?
faq.answer: Only with the permission of the Competent Authority. The officer also cannot advise or represent others in any matter adverse to the University's interest.
